tldr: This is a loose thread of unrelated model technical reports, not one developing event. It opened with Tencent Hunyuan's Hy-Nomas world-model report and benchmark on Oct 30, then MNN-Pocket-0.3B, a 300M-parameter on-device model with 32K context, on Nov 9.
whats_new: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview's report (Nov 18) describes a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35B total and 3B active parameters that supports a thinking mode.
why_it_matters: Each report shows a different serving shape: world models, sub-1B INT4 on-device models, and sparse diffusion LMs, each with its own inference cost and runtime needs.

beats.headline: Tencent Hunyuan publishes the Hy-Nomas report and Hy-Nomas-Bench
beats.summary: A lab report paired with a new benchmark for world models; coverage came via secondary press.

beats.headline: MNN-Pocket-0.3B targets on-device deployment at 300M parameters
beats.summary: A compact dense model with 32K context and an INT4 deployment path.

beats.headline: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview: a sparse MoE diffusion LM with thinking mode
beats.summary: 35B total and 3B active parameters, built on an adapted gated architecture per the abstract.

open_questions: Are the Hy-Nomas, MNN-Pocket-0.3B, or Clover weights released under a license that permits commercial use?
Does Hy-Nomas-Bench gain adoption outside Tencent's own evaluations?
Do mainstream inference servers support Clover's diffusion decoding, or does it need a custom runtime?
Do independent evals reproduce MNN-Pocket-0.3B's reported quality at INT4?
take_for_builders: Treat these as research reads. Before adopting one, check its weight license and runtime support, especially for Clover's diffusion decoding.

day_captions.2f7be7ac68b1edc1: Adds the small end of the range: a 300M on-device model with an INT4 path.
day_captions.b0b6c263afe6d2d0: Latest entry: a sparse diffusion LM, a different decoding approach from the autoregressive norm.
